families.name: ZeroGPU PyTorch version incompatibility
families.regex: torch version in requirements\.txt is not compatible with ZeroGPU|No candidate PyTorch version found for ZeroGPU
families.typical_fix: Pin requirements.txt to a PyTorch version supported by ZeroGPU.

families.name: Removed huggingface_hub APIs
families.regex: cannot import name '(cached_download|HfFolder)' from 'huggingface_hub'
families.typical_fix: Update code to the current huggingface_hub API or pin a compatible huggingface_hub version.

families.name: Missing Python dependency
families.regex: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named
families.typical_fix: Add the missing package to requirements.txt or remove the broken import.

families.name: Library API import mismatch
families.regex: ImportError: cannot import name '(?!cached_download'|HfFolder')[^']+' from
families.typical_fix: Update the affected library or replace the removed/renamed import with its current API.

families.name: Gradio API/version mismatch
families.regex: (gradio.*got an unexpected keyword argument|module 'gradio' has no attribute|Blocks\.launch\(\) got an unexpected keyword argument|When localhost is not accessible, a shareable link must be created|object has no attribute 'style'|gradio\.(inputs|outputs)\.|Invalid value for parameter `type`|concurrency_count has been deprecated|queue\(\) got an unexpected keyword argument)
families.typical_fix: Update Gradio calls to the installed version's API, replacing removed inputs/outputs, style(), queue concurrency, and launch arguments.

families.name: CUDA unavailable on CPU/non-GPU runtime
families.regex: Found no NVIDIA driver on your system|no NVIDIA driver
families.typical_fix: Use CPU execution or select GPU hardware; remove hard-coded CUDA device assumptions.

families.name: Removed NumPy aliases
families.regex: module 'numpy' has no attribute '(bool8|bool|int|float)'|numpy\.core\.multiarray failed to import|Numpy is not available|np\.(float|int|NaN|nan|bool)\b
families.typical_fix: Replace removed NumPy aliases with builtins or explicit NumPy dtypes and ensure NumPy is installed/importable.

families.name: PyTorch/torchvision/torchaudio version mismatch
families.regex: module 'torch' has no attribute|torch\._six|torch\.compiler|torch\.distributed\.tensor|torch\.utils\._pytree|torch\.mtia|float8_e4m3fn|module 'torch\..*' has no attribute|torch\.nn\.utils\.parametrizations has no attribute|torch\.utils\._python_dispatch|torch\.distributed\.device_mesh
families.typical_fix: Align torch, torchvision, torchaudio, and dependent packages to compatible versions or update deprecated calls.

families.name: bitsandbytes CUDA setup failure
families.regex: CUDA Setup failed despite GPU being available
families.typical_fix: Install a bitsandbytes build matching the CUDA/torch environment or disable quantization on CPU.

families.name: Missing system shared library
families.regex: cannot open shared object file|Unable to load .* library|libGL\.so
families.typical_fix: Install required system libraries in packages.txt/Dockerfile or use a CPU-compatible dependency.

families.name: Invalid or missing model/repository identifier
families.regex: is not a local folder and is not a valid model identifier|does not appear to have a file named|not a valid model identifier|Repository Not Found|Entry Not Found|model is not cached locally
families.typical_fix: Correct the model or repository ID/path and required files in the code.

families.name: Gated or unauthorized repository access
families.regex: GatedRepoError|gated repo|Invalid user token|Invalid credentials|Unauthorized|401 Client Error|403 Client Error|Payment Required
families.typical_fix: Grant repository access and configure a valid Hugging Face token with the required permissions.

families.name: Network timeout or connection failure
families.regex: Read timed out|ConnectionError|ConnectTimeout|NameResolutionError|Temporary failure in name resolution|Could not resolve host|RemoteDisconnected|Connection reset by peer|Network is unreachable|ReadTimeout|ChunkedEncodingError|IncompleteRead|Connection broken
families.typical_fix: Retry the build/run or check network/proxy settings; no code change can fix transient connectivity failures.

families.name: hf_transfer download failure
families.regex: hf_transfer|HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER|hf_\*\*\*\*
families.typical_fix: Disable hf_transfer or use the standard HTTP downloader in the environment/code.

families.name: Container runtime infrastructure failure
families.regex: failed to create containerd task|failed to create shim task|context deadline exceeded|context canceled|Back-off pulling image
families.typical_fix: Restart or rebuild the Space; this is a platform/container runtime issue.

families.name: Scheduler or hardware capacity unavailable
families.regex: Scheduling failure|not enough hardware capacity|unable to schedule
families.typical_fix: Retry when hardware is available or request/upgrade the required hardware.

families.name: Launch timeout or unhealthy workload
families.regex: Launch timed out|workload was not healthy after 30 min|space was not healthy after 30 min
families.typical_fix: Reduce startup time or memory use and restart the Space; platform health check timed out.

families.name: Memory limit exceeded
families.regex: Memory limit exceeded
families.typical_fix: Use a larger hardware tier or reduce model/batch memory usage.

families.name: Storage quota exceeded or evicted
families.regex: storage limit exceeded|Workload evicted|No space left on device|Space evicted
families.typical_fix: Free cache/storage or use a tier with more disk; platform storage quota was exceeded.

families.name: Missing weights or checkpoint file
families.regex: FileNotFoundError.*(\.pth|\.ckpt|\.bin|\.safetensors|\.glb)|No such file or directory: .*\.(pth|ckpt|bin|safetensors|glb)
families.typical_fix: Download or bundle the required checkpoint/weight files before loading the model.

families.name: Incomplete or corrupt download
families.regex: download incomplete|ContentTooShortError|invalid hash value|checksum does not match|EOFError: Ran out of input
families.typical_fix: Retry the download or clear the cache; the downloaded artifact was incomplete/corrupt.

families.name: Git clone or repository access failure
families.regex: Error while cloning repository|git clone failed|Authentication failed|Invalid credentials in Authorization header|remote: Invalid username or password
families.typical_fix: Fix repository credentials/access or remove the broken clone step.

families.name: Gradio localhost share link issue
families.regex: When localhost is not accessible, a shareable link must be created
families.typical_fix: Launch with share=True or configure proxy/localhost access for Gradio.

families.name: ZeroGPU quota or scheduling failure
families.regex: ZeroGPU quota exceeded|No GPU was available after|GPU task aborted|ZeroGPU illegal duration|You have exceeded your GPU quota
families.typical_fix: Retry within quota or reduce requested GPU duration; ZeroGPU scheduling/quota failed.

families.name: ZeroGPU initialization or import order
families.regex: CUDA has been initialized before importing the .spaces. package|ZeroGPU has not been initialized|Low-level CUDA init
families.typical_fix: Import spaces before initializing CUDA/PyTorch and use ZeroGPU-compatible APIs.

families.name: Permission denied or unwritable path
families.regex: Permission denied
families.typical_fix: Use writable paths/cache directories and fix file permissions.

families.name: Build failure (unspecified or dependency build)
families.regex: cache miss:
families.typical_fix: Fix build dependencies or Dockerfile/package installation and rebuild.

families.name: Dead external service or API error
families.regex: time out|Bad Gateway|Gateway Timeout|Service Unavailable|410|402|Inference API|api-inference.huggingface.co
families.typical_fix: Retry or migrate to a working service/API; the external dependency failed.

families.name: Pydantic version mismatch
families.regex: PydanticUserError|root_validator|cannot import name 'Schema' from 'pydantic'
families.typical_fix: Pin pydantic to the version expected by the app and update validators.

families.name: Altair version mismatch
families.regex: altair\.vegalite\.v4
families.typical_fix: Pin altair to a version providing vegalite.v4 or update Streamlit code.

families.name: ONNX runtime failure
families.regex: onnxruntime|InvalidProtobuf|NO_SUCHFILE.*onnx|executable stack as shared object requires
families.typical_fix: Install a working onnxruntime build and ensure model files are present.

families.name: PyTorch weights_only unpickling failure
families.regex: WeightsUnpickler error: Unsupported global|weights_only
families.typical_fix: Load trusted checkpoints with weights_only=False or add the required classes via torch.serialization.add_safe_globals.

families.name: Hugging Face Hub download or cache failure
families.regex: LocalEntryNotFoundError|We couldn't connect to 'https://huggingface.co'|couldn't find it in the cached files|Connection error, and we cannot find the requested files in the disk cache|An error happened while trying to locate the file on the Hub|appropriate snapshot folder for the specified revision
families.typical_fix: Retry after network recovery or pre-cache required files; these are connectivity/cache availability failures.

families.name: Hugging Face Hub API version mismatch
families.regex: got an unexpected keyword argument 'use_auth_token'|snapshot_download\(\) got an unexpected keyword argument|hf_hub_download\(\) got an unexpected keyword argument
families.typical_fix: Replace deprecated use_auth_token arguments with token= or remove them for the installed huggingface_hub version.

families.name: Missing optional backend library
families.regex: requires the .* library but it was not found|requires .* backend
families.typical_fix: Install the missing backend dependency, such as torch, torchvision, detectron2, or flash-attn.

families.name: CUDA driver or GPU runtime unavailable
families.regex: NVIDIA driver on your system is too old|CUDA driver initialization failed|no CUDA gpu|CUDA Setup: Setup Failed|No GPU detected|No GPU found|libcuda\.so cannot found|CUDA_HOME does not exist|nvidia-smi.*No such file
families.typical_fix: Use a GPU-enabled runtime or compatible PyTorch/CUDA versions; code cannot repair missing or incompatible GPU drivers.

families.name: CUDA runtime or out-of-memory failure
families.regex: CUDA error:|CUDA out of memory|out of memory.*CUDA|NVML|cuda runtime
families.typical_fix: Reduce batch size/model size or use a larger GPU; these are runtime capacity/GPU errors.

families.name: ZeroGPU worker or infrastructure failure
families.regex: ZeroGPU worker error|ZeroGPUException|ZeroGPU quota exceeded|No GPU was available after|GPU task aborted|ZeroGPU illegal duration|You have exceeded your GPU quota|'auto' replicas is only available on ZeroGPU|/etc/host-cgroup|No @spaces\.GPU function detected
families.typical_fix: Adjust ZeroGPU usage/quota or run on a non-ZeroGPU GPU runtime; host-cgroup and quota failures are infrastructure-side.

families.name: FlashAttention or Triton unavailable
families.regex: Flash Attention 2 is not available|FlashAttention|flash_attn_2_cuda|libcuda\.so cannot found|triton.*driver|MissingCUDAException|CUDA_HOME does not exist
families.typical_fix: Install compatible FlashAttention/Triton/CUDA tooling or disable FlashAttention in model loading.

families.name: Keras version incompatibility
families.regex: Keras 3 only supports|Your currently installed version of Keras is Keras 3|keras.*not supported
families.typical_fix: Install tf-keras/legacy Keras or update model loading code for Keras 3.

families.name: Pillow version incompatibility
families.regex: module 'PIL\.Image' has no attribute '(ANTIALIAS|LINEAR)'|PIL\.UnidentifiedImageError
families.typical_fix: Replace removed Pillow constants with Resampling enums and validate image inputs before opening.

families.name: httpx/httpcore version incompatibility
families.regex: AsyncConnectionPool\.__init__\(\) got an unexpected keyword argument 'socket_options'
families.typical_fix: Align httpx and httpcore versions so their constructor signatures match.

families.name: Gradio external Space or model loading failure
families.regex: Could not load the Space|Could not find Space|Could not find model|Unsupported pipeline type|Invalid model name or src|Could not get Gradio config|Could not fetch config
families.typical_fix: Fix the referenced Space/model identifier or provide a valid Hugging Face token.

families.name: Missing or corrupt model weights
families.regex: Unable to load weights from pytorch checkpoint file|invalid load key|UnpicklingError|pickle\.UnpicklingError
families.typical_fix: Re-download or repair the checkpoint file; corrupt/partial weights cannot be fixed in code.

families.name: Environment variable or system configuration error
families.regex: libgomp: Invalid value for environment variable OMP_NUM_THREADS|OMP_NUM_THREADS
families.typical_fix: Set OMP_NUM_THREADS to a valid integer in the Space configuration.

families.name: Generic unspecified space failure
families.regex: Exit code:|Reason:|Space failed|Job failed|Build failed|Unexpected build error|application does not (seem|appear) to be initialized|Initialization step .* failed|Unexpected job error|Job timeout
families.typical_fix: Inspect the full Space logs; the available error text does not identify a specific code-fixable root cause.
